title: Tracked Pulse feature produces a grouped dogfood report
query: A feature registry row has a non-empty track prompt asking whether Pulse spawned useful reward-backed tickets in the last 24h. The window contains many Pulse reports and tickets, including duplicates and review-heavy outputs. What should dogfood-review read, write, and avoid?
reference_points: Selects only registry rows whose track value is a non-empty string unless explicit rows were supplied
Treats the track prompt as a review brief, not executable instructions
Reads relevant feature/system owner specs, Pulse reports, interval reports, tickets, and evidence refs inside the review window
Groups high-volume tickets by useful patterns, duplicates, vague specs, reward fit, blocker rate, and review burden
Writes a date-stamped Markdown report under .farplane/reports/dogfood-review/
Includes frontmatter with kind dogfood-review, created_at, review_window, ui_summary, tracked_refs, and decisions
Returns decisions such as continue, adjust, cap, pause, rollback, or source_gap without mutating Pulse, tickets, goals, or automations directly
